name: Accidentals

name: Acropolis Magazine

name: Acroyoga Club

name: Active Minds

name: Afghan Student Association

name: Agape Christian Fellowship
description: Agape is a family committed to the wholehearted pursuit of God and His love. We are a nondenominational Christian fellowship of students desiring to help people encounter and build a strong, foundational, and personal relationship with Christ.

name: AI Club at William & Mary

name: Alexander Hamilton Society at William & Mary
description: The Alexander Hamilton Society is a non-partisan, student-led organization that is dedicated to promoting constructive debate on basic principles and current issues in foreign affairs.

name: Alma Mater Productions

name: Alpha Chi Omega

name: Alpha Epsilon Pi

name: Alpha Kappa Alpha

name: Alpha Kappa Psi
description: AKPsi is the nation's oldest and largest gender-inclusive business fraternity. We offer professional development and social opportunities to students of all majors and grades.

name: Alpha Phi Omega

name: Alpha Psi Omega

name: Alpha Sigma Phi
description: The Alpha Sigma Phi fraternity is one of the oldest Greek organizations in the United States, having been founded at Yale in 1845. The Kappa Zeta chapter was established at W&M in 2021 and continues the mission of our founders "to Better the Man".

name: Alpha Tau Omega
description: Alpha Tau Omega is a Social Greek Letter Organization that emphasizes leadership, service, and brotherhood. Our fraternity focuses on leadership development to help college men develop their ability to be effective leaders for a lifetime.

name: Alternative Dispute Resolution Team
description: The Alternative Dispute Resolution Team is dedicated to training law students to utilize methods of dispute resolution other than litigation (negotiation, mediation, and arbitration) and enables them to practice those skills at competitions each year.

name: Alzheimer's Buddies
description: Alzheimer's Buddies pairs college students with dementia and Alzheimer's residents for weekly visits. We train students to befriend these residents, emphasizing personal connections and engaging activities, with the goal of improving cognition.

name: American Bosnian Collaboration Project
description: A summer service trip focused on education, research, and peace-building with a required government course in the spring semester. We send 4-7 students to Bosnia-Herzegovina to teach English, filmmaking, and non-violent communication in a four week camp.

name: American Constitution Society
description: The American Constitution Society embraces a progressive view of the United States Constitution and works to ensure that the institutions of American law reflect the highest values of our nation and serve the needs of all people.

name: American Lung Cancer Screening Initiative
description: ALCSI raises awareness of lung cancer and the importance of early detection while expanding access to life-saving screening for high-risk individuals. We educate our campus community, engage students in public health advocacy, and support local outreach.

name: American Sign Language Club

name: American Society of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology
description: The American Society of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology (ASBMB) promotes the study of biochemistry and molecular biology, scientific literacy and health awareness in the local community through outreach initiatives.

name: Archery Team
description: We are a club for archers of all levels, regardless of experience!

name: Armenian Students Association at William & Mary

description: AASI is a social justice organization dedicated to APIA activism.

name: Aspiring Sisterhood of Identity and Growth

name: Association for Computing Machinery
description: An interest group in all things related to computers and computing.

name: Association for Women Geoscientists
description: AWG is an international organization dedicated to serving underrepresented groups in the geosciences through education, outreach, and professional development.

name: Association of Latino Professionals for America at William & Mary
description: Uplifting and empowering Latine talent to pivot their professional careers through leadership development, professional workshops, and networking opportunities.

name: Association of Pre-Physician Assistants

name: WMFIRE
description: A student organization focused on advocating for immigrant rights and activism through education and empowerment.

name: WMSURE
description: coming soon

name: Women in STEM
description: WISE is an organization whose goal is to support women pursuing STEM fields at William and Mary. We strive towards this goal by creating a supportive, inclusive environment that fosters community building.

name: Women's Club Basketball
description: Basketball for women wishing to continue playing the sport they love

name: Women's Club Lacrosse
description: Our goal is to provide a fun and inclusive opportunity to women of all levels to learn, play, and practice lacrosse. We practice twice weekly on Busch Turf and schedule games/tournaments each semester through our league, the WCLO.

name: Women's Club Rugby
description: W&M Women's Club Rugby is a part of Division II National Collegiate Rugby in the Midatlantic Regional Conference. Our team is open to anyone to join, serving as a supportive and welcoming community on campus.

name: Women's Club Soccer
description: We operate as soccer sports club teams (our two teams being Green and Gold) that travel to other universities and host other schools in competitive games. We hold weekly practices, games, tournaments, play pick-up, fundraise, and have socials.

name: Women's Club Volleyball
description: We are the Women's Club Volleyball Program here at the College of William & Mary. All skill levels are welcome, and we currently offer 3 teams to cater to different levels of commitment & experience: Gold, Green, and White!

name: Women's Law Society
description: We are a law school student group that encourages and supports our members in their studies and their professional careers.

name: Women's Network
description: The Women's Network serves as a professional development resource for primarily female students across all academic fields, providing a network on campus that celebrates ambition and helps build personal connections.

name: Women's Ultimate Frisbee
description: We are the women's ultimate frisbee program here at the College! No previous experience is required, and we hold tryouts in the fall.

name: Wordshop -- Creative Writing Club
description: A club for those interested in creative writing to discuss, share, and grow their work.

name: Wren Journal
description: The Wren Journal is a conservative cultural magazine that promotes tradition, reason, and virtue on the campus of the College of William and Mary.

name: Wrestling
description: William & Mary Club Wrestling team competes in tournaments and other events under the guidelines of the NCWA (National Collegiate Wrestling Association). The club is beginner and advanced friendly.

name: Writing and Communication Center
description: At the Writing and Communication Center, we help you strengthen your writing and communication skills by providing resources, workshops, and individual support for all kinds of assignments and projects that require writing. Make an appointment today!

name: Year of the Arts
description: W&M is celebrating the Year of the Arts!

name: YIS:Tolkien Society at W&M
description: A discussion-based group that meets weekly to discuss topics related to the works of JRR Tolkien.

name: Young Democrats
description: We promote progressive policies and candidates through campaign work, political activism, and issue education on campus and in the Williamsburg Community. An official chapter of the Virginia Young Democrats.

name: Young Independents at the College of William and Mary
description: YI hosts weekly moderated discussions on politics ranging from current events and foreign policy to political philosophy and history. Members, through the exchange of ideas across the political spectrum, consciously promote healthy democratic values.

name: Young Life
description: Young Life at William and Mary is an organization seeking to help students grow in faith, community, and leadership.

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Incorporated
description: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. was founded on January 16, 1920 by five pearls on the campus of Howard University. The Xi Lambda chapter was charted on the campus of the College of William and Mary on April 10, 1982.
